original_items.native_meaning: Asset may be physical, software or intangible; organization value/custody is its scope
AAS is standardized digital representation of an asset
original_items.caveat: Not the physical asset or native CSAPI System

original_items.native_meaning: Instance asset is particular uniquely identifiable asset, not only physical equipment
Type asset describes common features of assets; instances need not exist
original_items.caveat: Not always a marketed model designation

original_items.native_meaning: One AAS represents exactly one asset through assetInformation
original_items.caveat: Do not infer universal DIM or maximum-one-shell-per-asset cardinality

original_items.native_meaning: AssetAdministrationShell inherits Identifiable; derivedFrom is optional reference to predecessor AAS
assetInformation mandatory 1; referenced submodels 0..* and may be temporarily absent
original_items.caveat: Submodels are information aspects, not physical units

original_items.native_meaning: AssetInformation.assetKind required one; asset ID and kind information separate from shell ID
globalAssetId optional 0..1; specificAssetId 0..*, may lack global ID in early lifecycle
assetType optional type-asset ID even for type assets; instance may link Type
AssetKind: Type, Instance, Batch, Role, NotApplicable
SpecificAssetId name/value required, externalSubjectId optional; not necessarily globally unique
At least globalAssetId or one specificAssetId must be defined
original_items.caveat: Cross-field native constraint; not Profile SHALL

original_items.native_meaning: SpecificAssetId.externalSubjectId must be ExternalReference
original_items.caveat: Does not prove manufacturer or ownership

original_items.native_meaning: globalAssetId is reserved SpecificAssetId/name with defined semantics
HasKind.kind Template/Instance; optional default Instance; governs submodel modeling
Submodel globally identifiable aspect of represented asset; SubmodelElements 0..*
Identifiable.id globally unique mandatory 1; administration optional
original_items.caveat: Shell/submodel record ID not asset/system ID

original_items.native_meaning: Referable.idShort is contextual name; displayName and description may be multilingual; category deprecated
original_items.caveat: idShort not globally unique individual equipment ID

original_items.native_meaning: Non-identifiable referables must have idShort except direct children of SubmodelElementList
idShort unique within namespace, case-sensitive
AdministrativeInformation optional on identifiable; version, revision, creator, creation/update time concern model business lifecycle
original_items.caveat: Not live sensor status, firmware or Observation time

original_items.native_meaning: Revision may exist only with version
ExternalReference to external entities versus ModelReference to AAS elements; identifier need not be locator
original_items.caveat: Reference does not establish reachability or physical attachment

original_items.native_meaning: Reference.type required; key ordered 1..*; external or model reference
Key.type and value mandatory; global/model/fragment key meanings differ
original_items.caveat: Not necessarily device ID or URL

original_items.native_meaning: First reference key globally identifiable
External reference first key generic globally identifiable
Model reference first key AAS identifiable
RelationshipElement first/second references and semanticId carry relationship meaning
original_items.caveat: Physical part-of and actual cables not automatic

original_items.native_meaning: Entity SubmodelElement describes parts of composite asset or bill of materials, optional IDs
SelfManagedEntity requires global or specific asset ID
Instance asset need not have type asset
Two physically distinct temperature sensors may have distinct instance shell IDs and a separate type shell
original_items.caveat: Simplified publisher example not real Glaux case

original_items.native_meaning: URL-shaped identifiers need not resolve to accessible resources
Resource.path denotes file locator, absolute or relative
HasSemantics.semanticId optional 0..1; supplementalSemanticId 0..*
Supplemental semantic ID requires main semantic ID
Shell, Submodel and ConceptDescription globally identifiable; properties locally referable
Global asset ID optional in card but emphasized for exchange with partners
AAS type/template different from AAS instance; AAS types out of document scope
original_items.caveat: Separate type axis from asset type

original_items.native_meaning: Business createdAt and updatedAt optional

special_native_schema_observations.observation: JSON required list names assetKind, while AASd-131 cross-field identity condition is separate; a JSON required-array check is not full original AAS norm validation.
JSON idShort property exists but is not unconditionally required; native AASd-117 creates conditional idShort obligation.
JSON version/revision definitions are pattern-constrained strings, while original common prose describes numerical values; encoding interpretation remains distinct from business model semantics.
JSON requires assetInformation and inheritance chain requires Identifiable.id, while optional submodels array has minItems when present; this does not change original 0..* cardinality.

open_holds.detail: Current 15-column canonical master has no AAS donor column; owner must approve exact column insertion before any donor display-cell publication.
Globally unique AAS/Identifiable.id, represented asset globalAssetId, specificAssetId, contextual idShort and actual equipment serial/CSAPI URI have different referents.
AAS derivedFrom, Submodel, RelationshipElement and Entity may express model relations but do not prove physical part-of, current installation, live connection or vendor-specific real hardware.
AASd-131 and AASd-117 native constraints are not fully represented by selected JSON required arrays. No entire original schema validation/conformance claimed.
Tagged source wrapper PlantUML includes remote working-branch class partials; published rendered figure equality not independently authenticated.
Part1 prose describes numeric version/revision while original JSON schema uses digit-pattern string; interpret as source-specific representation and flag exact type semantics for later review.
Overview says every SubmodelElement needs semantic definition while HasSemantics.semanticId cardinality is 0..1 and SubmodelElement text recommends it; no premature new generic required field.
Other original native constraints/diagrams, Part2 interfaces, aligned Part3a/b/4/5 and original external IEC references not fully audited; prior AAS01 seven holds preserved.
